data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 inherits SRC_003: both artifacts share the shared mechanism of forbidding an identity homogenization mutation that collapses a structured identity comparison to a partial key, yet SRC_004 generalizes the endpoint-level comparison to the temporal layer while SRC_003 anchors it to school-ID seat binding. This inheritance is refuted if SRC_004's temporal precondition (refusal before provider call) depends on a non-identity-based mechanism orthogonal to SRC_003's partial-match collapse, severing the structural homology.
